interface RescueApiRow {
  rescueId?: string | number; rescueNo?: string; complexName?: string; regionName?: string
  contactName?: string; contactPhone?: string; urgentLevel?: string; dangerDesc?: string
  supportDesc?: string; attachUrl?: string; status?: string | number; createTime?: string
  title?: string; street?: string; community?: string; subdistrictName?: string; communityName?: string
  logs?: Array<{ operator?: string; operateTime?: string; content?: string; src?: string; act?: string; time?: string; text?: string }>
}
function mapRow(r: RescueApiRow): Order {
  const level = URGENT_NUM[String(r.urgentLevel ?? '')] ?? 2
  const area = String(r.complexName || '物业管理区域')
  return {
    id: String(r.rescueId ?? ''),
    no: String(r.rescueNo || ''),
    level, status: backStatus(r.status ?? 0),
    title: String(r.title || area),
    created: String(r.createTime || ''),
    reporter: String(r.contactName || '—'),
    area, region: String(r.regionName || ''), street: String(r.street || r.subdistrictName || ''), community: String(r.community || r.communityName || ''),
    owner: String(r.contactName || '—'), phone: String(r.contactPhone || ''),
    desc: String(r.dangerDesc || ''), need: String(r.supportDesc || ''),
    photos: String(r.attachUrl || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    nodes: (r.logs || []).map(l => ({ src: String(l.operator || l.src || '物业企业'), act: String(l.act || ''), time: String(l.operateTime || l.time || ''), text: String(l.content || l.text || '') })),
  }
}
